'''2009 Bespin Regionals Dan Albright DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Dan Albright]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Dann Albright
* '''Deck name:''' Pacific Blue 4
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
